answer: To resist Sybil attacks in an AI agent economy, an unforgeable identity bridge must connect agents to a decentralized ledger, ensuring reputation cannot be inflated without a corresponding cost. Agents must bridge their credentials through a permissioned verifier, producing a mirror of their provenance. This protocol forces attackers to burn verifiable computational timber—cryptographic proofs of resource expenditure—to mint new identities, making mass fake-identity generation economically unviable since the cost scales linearly with each created agent.
